summary: Space Mission Design Game is a Windows game for students. A crew of four (commander-scientist, navigator, engineer and comms officer) designs a space mission, launches it and flies it. Mass, power, budget, data, link and time are tied together, so every choice has a price. Spacecraft paths follow Newton's law of gravitation. The 9 campaign missions are modelled on real spacecraft, from TIROS-1 to Rosetta, and after each flight the report compares the player's project with the real mission. The game includes solo, one-screen and online modes, an Orbit Lab mode and 44 mini-games. It runs offline in Ukrainian and English. Built with C++ and Dear ImGui, using NASA and ESA mission data.
